Replay assumptions

All replays start by paying nine operations for the same three assayed compounds. Each further batch chooses up to four targets. Every policy pays for actual preparations, retains intermediate stock and receives assay results at batch completion. The top axis shows cumulative operations in this simulation. Route depth counts the operations along the longest dependency chain of the selected starting route.

SAR only ranks by predicted affinity plus the shared novelty bonus. Synthesis steps count toward its total, but carry zero weight in selection. Fixed pricing ranks with the original synthesis quote. Updated pricing ranks with the current quote, including retained stock. SAR + local FEP uses updated pricing and replaces SAR estimates with ideal affinity predictions wherever an assayed reference has an OpenFE/LoMap edge scoring at least 0.90. Local FEP only restricts proposals to those neighbours. The cost-aware rules use a penalty of 0.5 × ln(quoted operations), with quotes floored at one. FEP queries have no synthesis charge.

The guided replay uses paired start 28 of 128. Affinities in the replay come from the patent dataset. The historical order of experiments is unknown. Results across 128 starts ↗
